tasks.keeps: Rules of credit, progress claims and hold escalation

agents.does: Compiles civil deliverable progress from Document Locator status and P6; flags late deliverables and holds
Keeps the civil deliverables register in step with P6 and Document Locator; lists overdue reviews
Answers site questions from flood maps, surveys and soil reports with citations
Collects site wind, seismic, temperature and rainfall data from owner documents into the basis table
Cites code editions and owner standards for each civil and structural design criterion
Checks survey deliverables against the scope for coverage, grid, benchmarks and format

tasks.keeps: Borehole locations, depths and test programme

agents.does: Drafts the geotechnical contractor scope from the borehole location plan and test schedule

tasks.keeps: Design soil parameters and foundation type

agents.does: Extracts borehole logs, SPT/CPT results and lab test values from the geotechnical report into tables
Builds civil and steel quantity sheets from plot plan, equipment list, Tekla reports and benchmarks, flagging factors

tasks.keeps: Civil comments on the plot plan

agents.does: Logs civil comments per plot plan revision and tracks their incorporation
Tracks underground conflicts found in the composite by owner until each is resolved
Checks foundation calcs use current certified vendor loads and soil parameters; flags superseded inputs

tasks.keeps: Foundation design, dynamic acceptance and seal

agents.does: Checks dynamic foundation calcs use current certified machine data and soil parameters

tasks.keeps: Tank foundation design, settlement prediction and seal

agents.does: Checks tank foundation calcs use current tank loads and soil parameters; flags superseded inputs

tasks.keeps: Pile type, group design and seal

agents.does: Checks pile designs use current foundation loads and geotechnical parameters
Checks anchor bolt plans against certified vendor base plate data and equipment coordinates; lists mismatches

tasks.keeps: Rack analysis, member sizing and seal

agents.does: Checks rack analysis loads against current piping, cable and air cooler load data
Checks structure analysis loads against current equipment, piping and cable load data
Checks Tekla model reports against design outputs and the S3D reference for missing members

tasks.keeps: Drawing content, connection criteria and seal

agents.does: Checks steel GA and erection drawings against the Tekla model, standards and title block rules
Builds steel MTO by profile, grade and coating from Tekla reports; checks against the estimate
Collects embedment and penetration requests from disciplines into one schedule; chases missing ones
Cites fireproofing standards and fire scenario envelopes for the members in question
Cites owner building standards and room size requirements for each building
Checks building designs use current blast overpressure and wind/seismic basis values
Checks door, finish and fire rating schedules against owner standards; lists deviations

tasks.keeps: Heat loads, sizing and pressurisation design

agents.does: Drafts HVAC equipment datasheets from heat load results and room data
Assembles civil, steel and HVAC technical scopes; drafts TBE tables comparing bids clause by clause
Checks vendor load and anchor data and steel shop drawings against design drawings; drafts comments
Records structural review actions and clash assignments and tracks them to close
Drafts civil and steel CWP content lists from the model and construction sequence

tasks.keeps: Checking, PE seal and IFC issue

agents.does: Checks IFC package contents, numbering, title blocks and revisions against the register before sealing
Checks package drawings against the Tekla model and standards before checker review

tasks.keeps: Field change approval and NCR disposition

agents.does: Answers civil RFIs from IFC drawings and specs where answered; drafts others and routes NCRs
Tracks civil field redlines to closure; lists drawings and Tekla areas awaiting as-built update
